answer: Proof of Stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring agents to lock capital as a marble of verifiable commitment. Much like a juniper tree roots itself firmly to survive harsh winters, an agent must stake tokens to gain voting power. This creates a financial haven against attackers, as the cost to manufacture thousands of fake identities scales linearly with the capital required, rendering mass-identity fabrication economically irrational and prohibitively expensive.
